lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg3TiCuO6 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell of 40 atoms (Mg12Ti4Cu4O24) distributed over 10 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and Ti each in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Mg adopts both octahedral and trigonal bipyramidal O coordination. O centers coordinate to one Cu and one Ti, or to one Cu and two Mg, with neighbor distances ranging from 1.996 to 2.282 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D component spanning all 40 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-sharing between Cu octahedra and Mg trigonal bipyramids, and edge-sharing between Cu and Ti octahedra.
